verdict.rationale: Anytype documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants work with its API through natural language. It also ships an open-source Agents Skill that gives Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot and other agent tools safe read, search and modify access to Objects. Both sit on a localhost API with a published OpenAPI spec and a headless CLI. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these connectors work in practice; there is also no evidence of a broader third-party AI plugin ecosystem beyond the first-party connectors.
